crossRefs.note: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”
Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for…
Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.
House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.
Who can find a worthy woman? For her price is far above rubies.
The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley.
Jacob fled into the country of Aram, and Israel served to get a wife, and for a wife he tended flocks and herds.
Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;

people.name: Mahlon
people.line: Husband of Ruth, son of Elimelech and Naomi.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Ruth
people.line: Moabite woman, ancestor of David and Jesus

translations.web: Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You are witnesses today.”
translations.bsb: Moreover, I have acquired Ruth the Moabitess, Mahlon’s widow, as my wife, to raise up the name of the deceased through his inheritance, so that his name will not disappear from among his brothers or from the gate of his home. You are witnesses today.”
translations.kjv: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye are witnesses this day.
translations.asv: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye are witnesses this day.
